profile.headline: Software Engineering Manager @ Baldwin Risk Partners | Technical Leadership, Mentoring
profile.summary:
Software Engineer Manager with over 20 years of experience in full-stack development using the Microsoft technology stack. The team benefits from technical leadership, mentoring, and collaborative problem-solving to deliver robust, scalable web applications.  

With a focus on fostering agile development environments, the organization is empowered to achieve consistent project outcomes. Expertise in .NET technologies enables seamless execution of initiatives that align with business goals. Dedicated to creating a positive, team-oriented culture that supports growth and innovation.
